content.title: How to watch Astros vs. Athletics: TV channel and streaming options for April 4
content.text: The Houston Astros visit the Athletics at 4:05 p.m. ET on Saturday. Tatsuya Imai (0-0, 13.50 ERA) gets the start for the Astros, who are 5-3 this season and first in the AL West. Luis Morales (0-1, 10.38 ERA) is the expected starter for the Athletics, who are 2-5 and fifth in the AL West.How to watch Houston Astros vs. Athletics Venue: Sutter Health Park Time: 4:05 p.m. ET TV: NBCS-CA and SCHN Watching in person? He has a 30% strikeout rate and a 10% walk rate in 30 plate appearances, and he has scored six total runs. In 27 plate appearances, Max Muncy has slashed .269/.296/.615 this season. He has hit two long balls (17th in MLB) and driven in five runs with a strikeout rate of 37% and a walk rate of 3.7%. He has stolen one base on one attempt and has scored six runs (16th in MLB).
